title: diffdesk subject
description: One change to review: a commit range plus the reasons for it. Unknown fields are allowed and shown in the 'More' table.

id.description: Subject ID: letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter or digit, without '..'. Unique inside its package.

package.description: Package name. Default: the first folder below the subjects folder.

origin.description: Who made the change, for example new or gpt.

recommended.description: Suggested verdict, for example accept, reject or user-decision.

decisions.description: IDs of decisions this change depends on.

summary.description: One sentence: what is wrong and what the change does.

why.description: Markdown with the reasons. LaTeX in $...$ is allowed.

refs.description: Paths or links to supporting documents.

repo.description: Absolute path of the git work tree.

base.description: Old side of the diff (usually the parent commit). Null if there is no diff.

head.description: New side of the diff. Null if there is no diff.

files.description: Files to review, relative to the repository. Empty: every file changed between base and head.

branch.description: Branch name. Default: the branch checked out in repo.

order.description: Position inside the branch when commit order cannot decide.

depends_on.description: IDs of subjects (or names of packages) this subject depends on.

tags.description: Free labels, searched by the filter box.
